page.overview:
Who is Betasuchus?

is an extinct genus of abelisaur theropod dinosaur that lived in the Late Cretaceous in the Netherlands. Living in the Maastricht Formation, it seems that Betasuchus is an opportunist carnivore that hunt hadrosaurs and eat carcass of dead marine reptiles near the coasts. It can swim, but by doing so, it become a prey to Mosasaurus.

Betasuchus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia section of Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006.

The same image seen in the Jurassic Park Institute was also used for art in one of the gift shops in Islands of Adventure.
